note: Protocol hashes refer to the local locked files used before the corresponding fresh-seed outcomes were generated. The repository summary is a post-run index; it is not itself the preregistration artifact.

G7.name: training-time consolidation confirmatory
G7.decision_rule: paired bootstrap 95% CI for progressive-minus-early and progressive-minus-late must both lie entirely below zero

G8.name: functional-transfer necessity confirmatory
G8.decision_rule: upper paired-bootstrap 95% CI < 0 for functional-minus-identity and functional-minus-shuffled

G9.name: functional-transfer budget dose-response confirmatory
G9.decision_rule: 50% fit budget must beat 25% and 100% must beat 50% by paired-bootstrap 95% CI

G10.name: structured-inheritance confirmatory
G10.decision_rule: inheritance-only must be worse than functional and hybrid inheritance+functional refinement must be better than random-init functional fitting by paired-bootstrap 95% CI
G10.note: The confirmatory summary contains the full locked protocol specification, but a separate lock file was not retained in the current mounted handoff directory. Do not invent a hash.

G11.name: autonomous consolidation confirmatory
G11.primary_endpoint: autonomous target attainment plus non-inferiority to Large and compiler-update cap
G11.decision_rule: 8/8 reach final 2-block; Auto/Large relative-PPL 95% CI upper < +2%; compiler updates <=232 for every seed

G15.name: staged-versus-direct-wait confirmatory
G15.primary_endpoint: held-out test PPL at identical final 2-block architecture
G15.decision_rule: staged-minus-direct paired-bootstrap 95% CI entirely below zero

G17.name: factorization-only equivalence confirmatory
G17.decision_rule: complete paired-bootstrap 95% CI must lie within preregistered equivalence band [-0.10,+0.10] PPL

integrity_note: An earlier 5300-series autonomous run had its protocol-lock file overwritten by another experiment. Those runs were explicitly downgraded to exploratory evidence and are not represented as confirmatory here.
